title: Loi sur la protection du consommateur (Consumer Protection Act)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre P-40.1 LOI SUR LA PROTECTION DU CONSOMMATEUR'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: Quebec's general consumer statute, administered by the Office de la protection du consommateur: prohibited practices, contract formalities, credit contracts, distance contracts and warranties. Residential tenancy is not here - the residential lease is governed by the Civil Code of Quebec, arts. 1892-2000, with the tribunal constituted by the Loi sur le Tribunal administratif du logement, RLRQ c. T-15.01.
